title: unit document front matter
description: This is argo-pack's OWN unit schema. law-plank reads it out of this workspace at runtime, exactly as it reads yours out of yours — no copy of it is bundled into any .vsix. If the law is worth applying to a workspace, it is worth applying here first.

id.description: Stable identity of the unit. Other units name it under `deps`, and docs/deps.toml records the edges between these ids.

pathway.description: How the work reaches a person. The pathway is a promise about where someone gets a say; C7 checks that the human words that promise owes are actually written down.

human_word.description: The points at which a person speaks. C7 requires the words the declared pathway owes.

weight.description: How much work this is. C8 applies at W1 and above.

deps.description: Ids of units this one depends on. C6 requires each to resolve in docs/units and to be recorded as an edge in docs/deps.toml.

design_ref.description: What this unit is being built against. Required at W1 and above.

deliverables.description: What this unit hands over. At least one is required at W1 and above.

open_questions.description: What is still not known. Never a failure — C5 only says they are still standing.
